sections.whatsHappening: You and the other parties must serve and file documents before certain events. At least 14 days before the settlement conference, serve on every other party and file with the court any document you will rely on at trial. This includes expert reports not attached to your claim or defence. You must also serve and file a list of proposed witnesses using Form 13A. At least 30 days before the trial date, any document served on all parties who were served with the notice of trial shall be received in evidence, unless the trial judge orders otherwise.
sections.whatToDoNext: Ensure you serve and file the required documents on time. Use Form 13A for your list of proposed witnesses. Keep detailed notes of how and when you serve documents. Prepare an affidavit of service to confirm who was served and how.
sections.whatHappensAfter: Once you serve and file your documents, they will be considered by the court. If you serve a document at least 30 days before the trial, it will be received in evidence unless the judge decides otherwise. If you wish to cross-examine a witness or author of a document served on you, you may summon them as a witness.
